source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape with layered ink-and-color mountains, misty water flats, a small boat, pine groves, pavilion, bridge, rocky foreground, and distant blue-green hills. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_mountain_mass
motifs.description: Isolate the tall upper-left mountain formation with rounded vertical peaks, pale green-gray washes, dark moss-dot ridgelines, and soft mist at the base; exclude nearby red seals and empty sky.
must_preserve: arched contour linework running down the cliff faces
granular dark moss dots along upper ridges and foothills
soft green-gray wash texture
mist-softened lower edges where the mountain meets the water plain

motifs.name: distant_right_blue_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the far right low mountain range across the water, including the pale blue-green triangular peaks and faint horizontal shoreline washes; exclude red seals at the far right.
must_preserve: thin pale ridge outlines
blue-green color accents on the main right peak
faint layered wash suggesting receding distance
soft horizontal mist transitions at the base

motifs.name: misty_water_flats
motifs.description: Isolate the central river and sandbar surface with horizontal ink-wash bands, small vegetated islands, and mist gaps between upper mountains and lower cliffs.
must_preserve: long horizontal gray wash strokes
broken dotted vegetation patches on sandbars
blank mist openings separating landforms
subtle shoreline curves and soft fading edges

motifs.name: mid_left_cliff_fir_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-left rocky cliff ledge topped with a dense stand of straight fir-like trees and shrub textures; include the sloping rock face below but not the boat or central water.
must_preserve: vertical dark tree trunks and fine needle marks
dense stippled shrub band along the ridge
rounded cliff contour lines and pale mineral washes
dark shadow accents at the cliff base

motifs.name: river_boat_with_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat on the central water with low roofed cabin, plank deck, and tiny blue-accented figures; keep only the boat, its occupants, and immediate faint water marks.
must_preserve: woven dark roof texture on the cabin
straight deck and hull linework
tiny standing and seated scholar/boatman figures
small blue-green color accents on clothing and cabin details

motifs.name: central_windswept_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the large middle pine group with sweeping horizontal branches, clustered needle tufts, pale trunks, and rocky support forms; avoid the pavilion below and bridge to the right.
must_preserve: radiating pine needle clusters at branch tips
sinuous branching structure crossing the center
pale textured trunks with dark bark spots
rock contours and sparse grass strokes directly supporting the trees

motifs.name: lower_left_pavilion_group
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion and terrace tucked among trees in the lower-left valley, including its roof, posts, railings, lattice windows, and immediate bank vegetation.
must_preserve: angular tiled roof geometry
fine post, railing, and lattice window linework
tiny blue-green interior figure/accent
surrounding grasses and tree trunks framing the building

motifs.name: lower_right_bridge_stream
motifs.description: Isolate the small rustic bridge crossing the lower-right stream with adjacent grassy banks and rounded rocks; exclude the large right hillside and nearby calligraphy.
must_preserve: thin bridge planks and support lines
curving stream-edge wash
short grass strokes along both banks
small rounded rock forms beside the crossing

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
